C0286.title: Negative Review Triggers SMS Bombing: Malicious Code and Privacy Databases Freely Available
C0286.summary: In June 2023, a researcher from Southern Metropolis Daily found that many netizens experienced SMS bombing after leaving negative reviews on e-commerce platforms, receiving hundreds of messages per day. Attackers exploited malicious code to hijack SMS verification login interfaces of multiple legitimate websites, sending a flood of verification code messages to specific phone numbers. Some website
